dialogue.origin: （今日はよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time today.)

dialogue.origin: （本日はよろしくお願いします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well. We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: （本日はよろしくお願いします。時間になったら始めさせていただきます）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well. We will begin at the scheduled time.)

dialogue.origin: （すみません。システム不具合で２回送ってしまいました。更新ができないようなので、試しに送っていますが、気になさらないでください）
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry. Due to a system glitch, I sent the message twice. It doesn't seem to be updating, so I'm sending this as a test. Please disregard it.)

dialogue.origin: （承知しました！）
dialogue.content: (Understood!)

dialogue.origin: 本日はありがとうございます。始めに、年齢、性別、相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you for being here today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 24歳、女性、彼についてです
dialogue.content: I'm 24, female, and it's about my boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。彼についてのご相談ですね。もう少し、詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. So you'd like to talk about your boyfriend. Could you please tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.origin: 付き合って1年くらいなんですけど、この前なんかリストラされてすごい落ち込んでて
dialogue.content: We've been dating for about a year, and he was laid off recently and has been really down about it.

dialogue.origin: 死にたいとか言うから怖くて
dialogue.content: He says things like he wants to die, and it's scaring me.

dialogue.origin: 多分本当には死なないと思うんですけど
dialogue.content: I don't think he'd actually go through with it, but...

dialogue.origin: 彼がリストラをされて落ち込んでいる様子なんですね。そんな姿をみるのはお辛いですね。
dialogue.content: So he was laid off and is feeling down. It must be very difficult for you to see him like that.

dialogue.origin: 辛いっていうか
dialogue.content: 'Difficult' isn't quite the word...

dialogue.origin: 正直もうちょっと面倒だなって
dialogue.content: To be honest, it's starting to feel like a bit of a hassle.

dialogue.origin: LINEでも電話でもグチグチ言ってくるし
dialogue.content: He complains endlessly on LINE and on the phone,

dialogue.origin: 会っても暗いから楽しくないし
dialogue.content: and when we meet, he's so gloomy that it's no fun,

dialogue.origin: あんまり外にも出たがらないし
dialogue.content: and he doesn't really want to go out much either.

dialogue.origin: でも次の仕事まだ探してなくて
dialogue.content: But he hasn't even started looking for a new job yet.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。彼が落ち込んで、相談者さんに弱音を吐いてきているのを、面倒だなぁと思ってらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you're feeling that it's a hassle when he's down and venting his frustrations to you.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: もう別れてもいいかなと思ってるんですけど
dialogue.content: I'm even thinking maybe I should just break up with him.

dialogue.origin: でも彼が自分で友だちにリストラされたーって言いふらしてて
dialogue.content: But he went around telling all his friends himself that he got laid off.

dialogue.origin: 今別れたら私がイヤな女に見えませんか？
dialogue.content: If I break up with him now, won't I look like a terrible person?

dialogue.origin: （すみません。システムがやっぱりおかしくてすぐに更新できずにタイムラグが起こってしまいます。。。ちょっと立ち上げなおすのでお時間いただいてもいいでしょうか）
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry, the system is still acting up and there's a time lag because it's not updating right away... Would it be alright if I take a moment to restart it?)

dialogue.origin: （了解です）
dialogue.content: (Okay.)

dialogue.origin: （お待たせしました）そうだったんですね。ご相談者さんは彼と別れてもいいなぁと思ってらっしゃるんですね。でも、今わかれるとリストラされた人だから別れた。と思われてしまいそうだと。。
dialogue.content: (Thank you for waiting.) I see. So you're feeling that you could break up with him, but you're worried that if you do it now, people will think you left him just because he got laid off.

dialogue.origin: なんか
dialogue.content: Well...

dialogue.origin: 仕事探したりしてるならまぁ応援しようかなって思うんですけど
dialogue.content: If he were at least looking for a job, I think I could support him, but...

dialogue.origin: ただただ落ち込むだけで何にもしてなくて
dialogue.content: he's just moping around and not doing anything.

dialogue.origin: 彼、自分が優秀だと思ってたみたいで、それが恥ずかしかったみたいで
dialogue.content: It seems he thought he was really competent, so he was embarrassed by it.

dialogue.origin: それでもうダメだ、死にたいって言うんです
dialogue.content: And so he says things like, 'It's over,' or 'I want to die.'

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ご相談者さんは、彼に前向きになってほしいんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you want him to be more positive and move forward.

dialogue.origin: あー
dialogue.content: Ah...

dialogue.origin: そうですね確かに
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true.

dialogue.origin: 本当にそれで死ねるとは思ってないけど、でも死んじゃったら怖いし
dialogue.content: I don't think he'd actually die over this, but I'm scared of what would happen if he did.

dialogue.origin: 彼が、死にたい、もうだめだと言ってきたときには、ご相談者さんはなんと答えているんですか？
dialogue.content: When he says things like, 'I want to die,' or 'It's hopeless,' what do you say to him?

dialogue.origin: それはそれで私のせいになりそうで
dialogue.content: And if that happened, I feel like it would be my fault.

dialogue.origin: あー
dialogue.content: Um...

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫だよって
dialogue.content: I tell him, 'It's going to be okay.'

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、本当に死んでしまうと思うと怖いですよね。自然なことだと思います。
dialogue.content: I understand. It's frightening to think he might actually die. I think that's a very natural feeling.

dialogue.origin: 次の仕事探せばいいじゃんって
dialogue.content: I tell him he should just look for another job.

dialogue.origin: 正社員じゃなくてもいいし
dialogue.content: 'It doesn't even have to be a full-time position.'

dialogue.origin: （ごめんなさい。やっぱり更新がうまくいかず。。。このままいきます）
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry, the update is still not working properly... I'll just continue as is.)

dialogue.origin: （はい！）
dialogue.content: (Okay!)

dialogue.origin: 自分が優秀だと思ってたっていうのがなんていうか
dialogue.content: The fact that he thought he was so capable is, how should I put it...

dialogue.origin: 痛いというかｗ
dialogue.content: It's kind of cringey, lol.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。ご相談者さんの、お気持ちは彼には伝えているのですか？
dialogue.content: I understand. Have you told him how you feel?

dialogue.origin: 気持ちですか？
dialogue.content: My feelings?

dialogue.origin: 別れようかとはまだ言ってません
dialogue.content: I haven't told him I'm thinking of breaking up yet.

dialogue.origin: わかりにくくてすみません。正社員ではなくても、仕事を探したらどうか？ということです。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for being unclear. I meant, have you told him your suggestion that he should look for a job, even if it's not a full-time position?

dialogue.origin: それは言ってます、もうしょっちゅう
dialogue.content: Oh, I tell him that all the time.

dialogue.origin: 無職の人にお金出してもらえないし
dialogue.content: I can't have an unemployed person pay for things,

dialogue.origin: ご飯食べに行くのとか私が出してて
dialogue.content: so when we go out to eat, I'm the one paying.

dialogue.origin: それは別にいいんですけど
dialogue.content: I don't really mind that, but...

dialogue.origin: 私が払うと彼はそれも辛いとか言うし
dialogue.content: when I pay, he says that makes him feel bad too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。そこで、“自分が優秀だ”という彼の思いがみてとれたんですね。励ましても聞いてくれないと、嫌になりますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. And that's where you saw his 'I'm so competent' attitude come through. It's frustrating when you try to encourage him and he doesn't listen, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: もうどうしろと？って感じで
dialogue.content: It makes me feel like, 'What am I supposed to do?'

dialogue.origin: あーそうです
dialogue.content: Ah, yes, exactly.

dialogue.origin: それでリストラされたらそれは恥ずかしいよねって思います
dialogue.content: I mean, if you think that way and then get laid off, I can see how that would be embarrassing.

dialogue.origin: 私が支えないといけないんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Do I have to be the one to support him?

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。何をいっても、受け入れてもらえないと、こちらも無力感がでますよね。
dialogue.content: I can understand that. When nothing you say is accepted, it can make you feel powerless, too.

dialogue.origin: 死ぬのだけはちょっとやめてほしいけど
dialogue.content: I just really don't want him to die, though.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですよ
dialogue.content: That's it exactly.

dialogue.origin: 別れたら私が悪く見える
dialogue.content: If I break up with him, I'll look bad.

dialogue.origin: 死なれたら私が悪く見える
dialogue.content: If he dies, I'll be blamed.

dialogue.origin: もうどうしたら？
dialogue.content: What am I supposed to do?

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。彼には前を向いてほしくて、いろいろと提案をしてみるけど、聞いてくれない。そんな彼といると相談者さんもうんざりしてしまって別れてもいいなぁと、、でも、死なれたら嫌だ。そんな感じでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. So you want him to move forward, and you try making various suggestions, but he won't listen. Being with him like this is making you fed up to the point where you feel you could break up, but you don't want him to die. Is that about right?

dialogue.origin: そうですそうです
dialogue.content: Yes, yes, that's it exactly.

dialogue.origin: そんな感じ
dialogue.content: That's exactly it.

dialogue.origin: このままだと私まで落ち込みそう
dialogue.content: If this continues, I feel like I'm going to get depressed too.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。落ち込んでいる彼に前を向いてほしい、そして彼をどうにかしてあげなければいけないという責任感が強い方のように思います。
dialogue.content: Thank you. It seems to me that you have a strong sense of responsibility, wanting your depressed boyfriend to look forward and feeling that you have to do something to help him.

dialogue.origin: 責任感というか
dialogue.content: A sense of responsibility... I'm not sure if that's it.

dialogue.origin: だから、落ち込んでしまいそうなんだと。例えば、ご相談者さんの友人が同じ境遇で彼と別れたとしたらご相談者さんはそのご友人のことをどう思いますか？
dialogue.content: And that's why you're starting to feel down yourself. For example, if a friend of yours were in the same situation and broke up with her boyfriend, what would you think of your friend?

dialogue.origin: 私の友だちの彼氏がリストラされたらってことですか？
dialogue.content: You mean, if my friend's boyfriend got laid off?

dialogue.origin: 別れた理由によるかな
dialogue.content: I guess it depends on the reason for the breakup.

dialogue.origin: メッセージが前後してしまってごめんなさい。ご相談者さんの言葉を切ってしまいました。責任感というかどんな気持ちでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I'm sorry if our messages got crossed. I believe I cut you off. You said it wasn't quite a sense of responsibility; what kind of feeling is it?

dialogue.origin: あーなんで私が彼のリストラのことで悩まなきゃいけないのって
dialogue.content: Ah... it's like, 'Why do I have to be the one worrying about his layoff?'

dialogue.origin: イライラする感じもあって
dialogue.content: There's a sense of irritation, too.

dialogue.origin: でも落ち込んでるのが本当ならちょっとかわいそうだけど
dialogue.content: But if he's genuinely down, I do feel a little sorry for him.

dialogue.origin: 落ち込んででもしょうがないし
dialogue.content: But being down about it won't change anything.

dialogue.origin: 元の会社には戻れないし
dialogue.content: He can't go back to his old company.

dialogue.origin: っていうのも言ってるんですけどね
dialogue.content: I've told him all that, too, you know.

dialogue.origin: お前にはわかんないとか言われて
dialogue.content: And he just says things like, 'You wouldn't understand.'

dialogue.origin: なんだ元気じゃん、みたいな
dialogue.content: And I'm like, 'What, you've got plenty of energy to say that, don't you?'

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。彼のことを放っておくこともできるのに悩むのはお優しいんだとお見受けしますよ。さきほどの質問に戻りますね。友達があなたの立場で、結果的にわかれた場合です。
dialogue.content: I see. You could just leave him be, but the fact that you're worrying about it shows that you are a kind person. Let's go back to my earlier question. Imagine a friend is in your position and ends up breaking up with her boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: んー
dialogue.content: Hmm...

dialogue.origin: 友だちの性格にもよるけど
dialogue.content: It depends on the friend's personality,

dialogue.origin: まぁあの子なら別れるよねって思う子もいるし
dialogue.content: for some friends, I'd think, 'Yeah, of course she would break up with him,'

dialogue.origin: その彼のことを知ってたら、ちょっとかわいそうだと思うかも
dialogue.content: and for others, if I knew the boyfriend, I might feel a little sorry for him.

dialogue.origin: 別れた後なんでもなければいいけど
dialogue.content: It would be fine as long as nothing happens after they break up, but...

dialogue.origin: 万が一本当に死なれちゃったりしたらちょっと
dialogue.content: if, by any chance, he actually ended up dying, then that would be a problem.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。ご友人や彼によって、気持ちが変わるということですね。彼がもし、彼が仕事を探しだしたらご相談者さんのお気持ちは変わりそうですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. So your feelings would change depending on the friend and the boyfriend involved. If he started looking for a job, do you think your feelings toward him would change?

dialogue.origin: それはそうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, they definitely would.

dialogue.origin: 仕事探ししてほしい
dialogue.content: I want him to look for a job.

dialogue.origin: だって
dialogue.content: Because...

dialogue.origin: 失業保険ももらますよね？
dialogue.content: he can get unemployment benefits, right?

dialogue.origin: それもやってない
dialogue.content: He hasn't even done that.

dialogue.origin: 俺仕事できるしって言ったたんだから、次の仕事でやればいいのに
dialogue.content: He was the one saying, 'I'm good at my job,' so he should just prove it at his next one.

dialogue.origin: 恥ずかしい死にたいってばっかり
dialogue.content: But all he says is, 'I'm so embarrassed, I want to die.'

dialogue.origin: 彼はリストラを恥ずかしいと思ってらっしゃるんですね。そこに固執して動かない彼に、ご相談者さんは怒りも感じておられるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So he feels that being laid off is embarrassing. Do you perhaps feel angry at him for being so fixated on that and not taking any action?

dialogue.origin: イライラしますね
dialogue.content: Yes, it irritates me.

dialogue.origin: 私のことは考えてくれないし
dialogue.content: He doesn't think about me.

dialogue.origin: 自分のことばっかり
dialogue.content: It's all about him.

dialogue.origin: リストラされた人の彼女って
dialogue.content: Being the girlfriend of someone who got laid off...

dialogue.origin: 私も恥ずかしいわ
dialogue.content: it's embarrassing for me, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。彼は、自分の気持ちだけ一方的にぶつけてきて、うけとるご相談者さんの気持ちに寄り添ってくれていない感じがするのですね。それは、悲しいしイライラしますね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you feel that he's just one-sidedly dumping his feelings on you, without considering how you feel on the receiving end. That must be both sad and irritating.

dialogue.origin: あーそうですね
dialogue.content: Ah, yes, that's it.

dialogue.origin: ちょっとならいいんですけど
dialogue.content: It would be fine if it were just for a little while,

dialogue.origin: 仕方ないと思うんだけど
dialogue.content: I know it's understandable, but...

dialogue.origin: もう２ヶ月くらいそんな感じだから
dialogue.content: it's been like this for about two months now.

dialogue.origin: ２か月は、長く感じますね。彼は他に弱音をはける相手はいないんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Two months must feel like a long time. Is there anyone else he can vent to?

dialogue.origin: 友だちには自分で言いふらしてましたよ
dialogue.content: He went and told all his friends himself.

dialogue.origin: リストラされた―って
dialogue.content: 'I got laid off.'

dialogue.origin: その直後に
dialogue.content: Right after it happened.

dialogue.origin: でも今は後悔してるみたいだけど
dialogue.content: But now it seems like he regrets it.

dialogue.origin: 言わなきゃよかったって
dialogue.content: He says, 'I wish I hadn't told them.'

dialogue.origin: プライド高いから
dialogue.content: Because he has a lot of pride.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ご相談者さんの前ではそのプライドをぬげる貴重な存在なんですね。死ぬという言葉がなかったら、別れたいという気持ちはどうでしょう？
dialogue.content: I see. So you are a precious person to him, someone in front of whom he can let go of his pride. If he wasn't saying he wants to die, how would you feel about breaking up?

dialogue.origin: あーそうですね
dialogue.content: Ah, that's a good question.

dialogue.origin: 絶対死なないなら別れるかな
dialogue.content: If I knew for sure he wouldn't die, I think I would break up with him.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。彼が前を向いて動きだしたら、（仕事を探したり）別れる気はなくなりそうだし、逆に今のままで死ななければ別たい。ということですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So if he started to move forward (like looking for a job), you probably wouldn't feel like breaking up. On the other hand, if things stay as they are and you knew he wouldn't die, you would want to break up. Is that right?

dialogue.origin: わー
dialogue.content: Wow.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 私そう思ってるんですね
dialogue.content: So that's what I'm thinking.

dialogue.origin: どっちでもいいのかな
dialogue.content: I wonder if I'm okay with either outcome.

dialogue.origin: 好きなのかどうなのかわかんなくなってきました
dialogue.content: I'm starting to not even know if I love him anymore.

dialogue.origin: お話しを伺っていて、そう感じましたがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That's the impression I got from what you've shared. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.origin: 嫌いではないけど、ずーっと暗いのは相手するのが面倒
dialogue.content: I don't dislike him, but dealing with someone who is gloomy all the time is a hassle.

dialogue.origin: つまんないし
dialogue.content: And it's no fun.

dialogue.origin: でも仕事してた時は普通に好きだった
dialogue.content: But when he was working, I liked him just fine.

dialogue.origin: だから仕事探してって言うんだけどな
dialogue.content: That's why I keep telling him to look for a job.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。暗い相手をするのは、こちらも暗くなってしまいますよね。彼がリストラされるまで２人で楽しんでいたことはどんなことでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I understand. Dealing with someone who is gloomy can bring you down as well. Before he was laid off, what kinds of things did the two of you enjoy doing together?

dialogue.origin: とにかく出かけてました
dialogue.content: We were always going out.

dialogue.origin: いろんなところ遊びに行って旅行も行って
dialogue.content: We'd go to all sorts of places for fun, and we'd go on trips, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。リストラされてからはどうですか？
dialogue.content: I see. And how have things been since he was laid off?

dialogue.origin: 彼が写真が趣味だったから
dialogue.content: He was into photography, so...

dialogue.origin: 家からほとんど出ませんね
dialogue.content: we hardly ever leave the house now.

dialogue.origin: たまに飲みに誘うとしぶしぶ出てくる
dialogue.content: Occasionally, if I invite him out for a drink, he'll come out, but reluctantly.

dialogue.origin: 今年は桜も見なかった
dialogue.content: We didn't even see the cherry blossoms this year.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね。しぶしぶだと、残念ですね。前の彼に戻ってほしいという気持ち、そんな彼が好きだったというお気持ちもわかりました。
dialogue.content: I see. It's a shame that he's so reluctant. I understand your desire for him to go back to how he was, and that you loved the person he used to be.

dialogue.origin: （すみません、最後までまとめられませんでした。うまくタイミングも合わせられずにすみません。問い合わせしてみます。。。
dialogue.content: (I'm sorry, I wasn't able to provide a full summary before the end. I apologize for the bad timing as well. I'll contact support...)

dialogue.origin: もしよろしければこれで終了させていただきます。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: If it's alright with you, we'll end the session here. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: （いえいえ、大変でしたね。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: (Not at all, that must have been difficult for you. Thank you so much!)

topic.sub: 彼のリストラに対する気持ちとコミュニケーション問題
